To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated with doxorubicin and NaCl for combined hyperthermia and chemo-therapeutics of cancer is reported.
the microwave-triggered drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated with salt and doxorubicine for the combined hyperthermia and chemotherapies of cancers has been demonstrated successfully.
microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated doxorubicin and salt for local combined hyperthermia and chemo therapy of cancer was achieved.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of a novel thermochemotherapy nanocarrier, DOX& NaCl@liposome, for the microwave-induced release of DOX from the liposomes co-encapsulated with DOX and NaCL, and the synergistic effect of microwave hyperthermia with chemotherapy for the treatment of cancer.
the development of a novel microwave-sensitive liposome system for combined microwave hyperthermia/chemotherapy of cancer.
the design and fabrication of a novel thermochemotherapy nanoplatform for cancer treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
microwave-triggered smart drug release from the DOX&NaCL@liposomes co-encapsulated DOX and salt for local combined hyperthermia and chemotherapeutic treatment of cancer is a promising strategy.

the microwave and temperature sensitive DOX&NaCL@liposomes were prepared successfully from DPPC, cholesterol, and DSPE-PEG200 with a molar ration of 4:0.26:1 by co-encapsulation of NaCl and DOX through the thin-films hydration method for external manipulation of drug release at a pre-determined location in the body and a desired time for combination microwave hyper-thermia and chemotherapy for cancer treatment.
microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated DOX and salt could serve as a potential thermochemotherapy nanomedical platform for the treatment of cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination therapy of hyperthermia and chemo-therapy could be realized by the microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulat- ing doxorubicin and salt.
microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated doxorubicin and salt for local combined hyperthermia and chemotherapies of cancer was developed.
microwave-triggered drug release could provide a novel strategy to improve the therapeutic effect of chemotherapy and hyperthermia for the treatment of cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the microwave-triggered smart drug release from liposomes co-encapsulated with DOX and salt for the combined hyperthermia and chemotherapies of cancer is an effective strategy to improve the treatment efficiency of cancers.

the co-loading of NaCl with DOX in the microwave sensitive liposomes can be an effective strategy to enhance the synergistic therapeutic effect of combination microwave hyperthermic chemotherapy for the treatment of cancer.

we have developed a new class of thermochemotherapy liposomes with excellent microwave-triggered smart drug release and good biocompatiblity, which could serve as a new type of nanomedicine for microwave-triggered combined hyperthermia and chemotheraphy of cancer.
